subject: Literature
title: Shakespeare's Influence on Modern Storytelling
description: A 60-second lesson on Shakespeare's Influence on Modern Storytelling.

hook.text: Every time you watch a romantic comedy or a political thriller, you are watching Shakespeare's influence.

buildup.text: He invented the tragic flaw, the comic subplot, the dramatic soliloquy, and the five-act structure we still use.

discovery.text: West Side Story is Romeo and Juliet. Ten Things I Hate About You is The Taming of the Shrew.

twist.text: Even writers who reject Shakespeare are defined by their opposition to him, making his influence inescapable.

climax.text: Shakespeare did not just write great plays. He created the grammar of storytelling that all Western culture uses.

punchline.text: Every story you love has Shakespeare's fingerprints.

quiz.question: Which modern film is a direct adaptation of Romeo and Juliet?
